dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a moderate concave curvature (falcate) from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Narrowly rounded apex with an obtuse morphological shape classification.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep posterior slant measuring approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Vertical pixel height is approximately 0.7x of the horizontal base pixel width.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Continuous moderate convexity forming a smooth arc from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio; distal tip is slightly rounded.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct interior angle of approximately 140-150 degrees at the junction where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular dark lesion or pigment spot on the mid-lateral flank; light-toned linear markings on the lateral surface of the rostrum.
other_distinctive_markers: Broad-based pectoral fin with a tapered distal edge; significant overexposure/bloom on the ventral and mid-lateral surfaces obscuring fine skin texture.
